Subject: Redwood starter credits for FieldSpark keynote

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for coordinating the keynote slot at the Summer Community Summit. Our marketing team asked whether we can get a small bundle of trial credits we can distribute to 10 panelists and 50 attendees (promo codes or direct account top-ups are both fine). Typical ask would be something like 5k tokens per panelist and 2k per attendee — we can provide names/emails once we have confirmation.

Two quick constraints on our side: 1) the credits need to be restricted so they can only be used against hosted inference (not downloadable model exports), and 2) we’d like the credits to expire 90 days after issuance.

Can you confirm if Redwood can issue this kind of sponsor starter pack and any paperwork you need? We can sign a simple addendum if needed.

Appreciate it — hope the prep is going smoothly.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, FieldSpark

--
FieldSpark, Inc.

Lena —

Thanks for the note and the clear scope. We can definitely put together a sponsor starter pack for FieldSpark. Quick summary of what we can offer:
- Panelist grants: 10 accounts × 5,000 token credits (hosted API only)
- Attendee promo codes: 50 single-use promo codes × 2,000 token credits (hosted API only)
- Expiry: 90 days from issuance

Next steps from our side: legal will need a brief addendum (one page) that covers permitted usage and expiry. Ops will provision the credits as either stacked promo codes (list csv) or direct account top-ups if you prefer.

Questions for you: 
1) Do you want account top-ups for panelists (we can issue to emails) or should we generate single-use codes for everyone?
2) Do you need the promo codes white-labelled (FieldSpark-branded) for distribution in your portal?

Looping in Marissa and Priyom to get cost approval and the logistics workbook. I’ll put a draft addendum on Drive and share after legal gives the ok.

—Alex
